title: Preferences
description: Theme, map, events, billing, social privacy, and system notifications — synced across Pulso family products.

empty.title: No preferences loaded
empty.description: Theme and language settings will appear here.

theme.title: Theme settings
theme.description: Customize colors, font, interface style, and display language.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language for PulsoLink and shared family products.

billingReceipt.title: Billing receipt
billingReceipt.description: Where receipt details sit in payment summaries.

map.title: Map settings
map.description: Configure map style and your location marker on the map.

event.title: Event settings
event.description: Control nearby fetch size, search radius limits, and which event modules appear on the Events page.

billing.title: Billing settings
billing.description: Control how payment receipts appear on the Spending page.

social.title: Social settings
social.description: Control who can interact with you and list visibility.

system.title: System settings
system.description: Manage account-related system notifications and preferences.

socialPrivacy.cardDesc: Control who can interact with you and which connection lists others can see.
socialPrivacy.sectionPoliciesDesc: Choose who can send friend requests, messages, or group invites.
socialPrivacy.sectionVisibilityDesc: Choose which social lists appear on your profile for others.
socialPrivacy.groupInvitePolicy: Who can invite you to groups
socialPrivacy.nobodyHint: No one can — select at least one option to allow.

billingPreference.title: Payment receipt position
billingPreference.desc: Choose where the receipt panel appears on the Spending page.

mapStyle.title: Map Style
mapStyle.desc: Choose the visual style for maps throughout the app
mapStyle.enableNearbyRange: Show nearby fetch range on map

locationMarker.title: Location Marker
locationMarker.desc: Customize the position dot and badge on the map. Clear a value to follow the current theme.
locationMarker.useProfilePhotoHint: When enabled, your profile photo is shown when available; otherwise the letter badge is used.
locationMarker.letterActiveHint: Applies when profile photo is off. Leave empty to derive one letter from your name, or type to override.
locationMarker.letterDisabledHint: Profile photo is on, so letter settings are inactive. Turn photo off to customize the letter badge.

eventPreference.cardDesc: Customize how Explore and Events fetch nearby content from the map viewport.
eventPreference.modulesDesc: Turn categories on or off on the Events page. Off modules are hidden from lists and the home grid.
eventPreference.fetchDesc: Page size applies to Explore pins and Event Home lists. Radius limits clamp the viewport-derived search area.
eventPreference.pageSizeHint: {{min}}–{{max}} items. Controls how many nearby events load per page on Explore and Event Home.
eventPreference.radiusMinHint: {{min}}–{{max}} m. Viewport-derived search radius will not go below this value.
eventPreference.radiusMaxHint: {{min}}–{{max}} m. Viewport-derived search radius will not exceed this value.

systemSettings.cardDesc: Manage system email notifications related to your account security.
systemSettings.loginEmailNotificationDesc: When enabled, you will receive an email each time you sign in successfully.
